corresponding provision of at least one test as follows:

functionality can be merged unless accompanied by at least one test.

variants.A:
`GET /api/articles`

Returns most recent articles globally by default, provide `tag`, `author` or `favorited` query parameter to filter results

Query Parameters:

Filter by tag:

`?tag=AngularJS`

Filter by author:

`?author=jake`

Favorited by user:

`?favorited=jake`

Limit number of articles (default is 20):

`?limit=20`

Offset/skip number of articles (default is 0):

`?offset=0`

Authentication optional, will return [multiple articles](/specifications/backend/api-response-format#multiple-articles), ordered by most recent first
variants.B: GET /api/articles lists articles globally, newest first by default. The tag, author, and favorited query parameters respectively filter by tag, author, and the user who favorited the articles (examples: tag=AngularJS, author=jake, favorited=jake). The limit query parameter limits the number of articles and defaults to 20. The offset query parameter skips articles and defaults to 0. Authentication is optional. Return [multiple articles](/specifications/backend/api-response-format#multiple-articles), ordered with the most recent first.
variants.C:
`GET /api/articles`

Returns most recent articles globally by default, provide `tag`, `author` or `favorited` query parameter to filter results

Query Parameters:

Filter by tag:

`?tag=AngularJS`

Filter by author:

`?author=jake`

Favorited by user:

`?favorited=jake`

Limit number of articles (default is 20):

`?limit=20`

Authentication optional, will return [multiple articles](/specifications/backend/api-response-format#multiple-articles), ordered by most recent first

obligations.text: List articles using GET /api/articles.
Default listing is global and ordered most recent first.
Support filtering by tag through tag query parameter.
Support filtering by author through author query parameter.
Support filtering by favoriting user through favorited query parameter.
Support limit query parameter with default 20.
Support offset/skip query parameter with default 0.
Authentication is optional.
Return multiple articles.
